decisions.reason: The 72-hour express program still offers a distinct speed advantage at low keeping cost while demand uncertainty remains, so the firm keeps the option open.
The fire-resistant exterior door has European approval and home-page visibility, signaling realized value, so the firm keeps it.
The multi-model express delivery line has its own page and covers multiple segments, so the firm keeps this option to resolve remaining demand uncertainty.
The online platform remains a strategic digital option with its own page and high uncertainty about digital-service demand, so the firm keeps it.
The fire and smoke protection door is only mentioned and overlaps with the featured fire-resistant door and existing range, so its marginal option value is low and the firm drops it.
